thread.title: Dollar Dumps, Stocks Jump As 'Bad News Is Good' Storms Back

author: kring
title: Dollar Dumps, Stocks Jump As 'Bad News Is Good' Storms Back
text: in General Dismal data from ISM surveys brushed off because of Powell's promises, desperate China liquidity injections, and trade talk hope...Despite RRR cuts, China's bank stocks went nowhere on the day, but CHINEXT (small tech) surged... Markets - Beta - Ital - Spain - Rest European markets were just as mixed with high beta Ital and Spain outperforming while the rest of EU's majors ended red...From the dismal ISM Services print, stocks surged but bonds, the dollar, and gold limped lower... Bad - News - News - Again "Bad news is Good news" Again!US equities soared on the bad news but once President Trump announced his address tomorrow - which could be good news for the shutdown - stocks did not like it...Small Caps massively outperformed today, Dow was least best... Plunge - Protection - Team AAPL didn't rally with the market today... Push - AMZN - World - Company Which helped push AMZN to the world's most valuable company...Tech stocks ramped up to Jan 2nd highs but faded into the close... Credit - Markets - Squeeze - HYG Credit markets continued their huge squeeze higher with HYG surging back to its 200DMA...IG and HY credit spreads have compressed notably, along with VIX... Treasuries - Today - Long-end - Saw - Yields Treasuries were mixed today but broadly speaking sold as the long-end outperformed and short-end saw yields up 3-4bps...Which flattened the yield curve...
